integrity: A direct scheme-theoretic two-chart proof establishes the global nilradical and Plucker polynomial. Exact polynomial and Groebner computations supplement but do not substitute for the all-degree proof. A comparison to a published preprint makes a specific mathematical inconsistency explicit rather than assuming novelty from absent search results.
scientific_limitations: The degree bound is d>=2, standard rational normal embeddings only, and the characteristic is arbitrary. The final journal version of the closest 2014 paper was not available for full-text comparison; the accessible 2014 arXiv version was inspected. Full historical priority and independent scientific validation remain open.
title: Twisted Fano ribbons on cones over rational normal curves
